description.text:
Stellar Crystal (星彩晶璃) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 15 May 2026 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. It brought the Stellar Tera type, which holds the power of every type and is said to be closely tied to the Legendary Pokémon Terapagos. A Stellar Tera Pikachu, its Tera Jewel shining on its head, is on the cover. Its Stellar Tera Pokémon ex have attacks that need Energy of three different types: costly, but with very strong damage or effects. Its Pokémon ex include Terapagos ex, Pikachu ex, Hydrapple ex, Archaludon ex, Sylveon ex, Latias ex and Zacian ex. Its new ACE SPEC cards include Grand Tree, Megaton Blower and Amulet of Hope, and its Supporters include Blueberry Academy's Elite Four Drayton, Lacey and Crispin, with Briar, Clemont's Quick Wit and Lisia's Appeal.

The Stellar Crystal coin set (星彩晶璃硬币套装) came out the same day: three 5-card packs, one of 30 chosen holos (five Pokémon ex and 25 Common, Uncommon or Rare Pokémon, in Poké Ball pattern or, one time in a hundred, Master Ball pattern) and a coin of that Pokémon in one of two regular styles or a rare gold one. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. Its main cards are numbered out of 208; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 266.
